This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

From explosive Nerf footballs and baseball grenades to Australian boomerang bombs, British sticky bombs, and Japanese ceramic grenades, military engineers have experimented with some truly bizarre weapons. Discover the strange ideas behind these unusual grenade designs, how they worked, and why some proved more dangerous to their users than their enemies.
